text.en:
A national high school is hereby established, in the Municipality of Maimbung, Province of
Sulu, to be known as the Maimbung National High School.

Such sum as may necessary for the operation and maintenance of said school shall be provided
in subsequent General Appropriations Acts, until which time the operation of the institution as a national high
school shall be deferred.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
